نتم (form I)
# نَتِمُّ (natimmu) /na.tim.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَمَّ (tamma)
# نَتِمَّ (natimma) /na.tim.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَمَّ (tamma)
# نَتِمِّ (natimmi) /na.tim.mi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَمَّ (tamma)
